reviews.t: I am satisfied with this purchase
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:3e53cbdd82b422eb50b92923af93ce42]] I am very satisfied with this water flosser. It has 4 modes of Normal, Soft, Pulse and Point Control, you can choose your favorite mode. The water capacity is very large, so you don't have to fill the water multiple times during use. Overall, this is a great product!

This water flosser is very effective and clean. It is very easy and convenient to use.  Just fill it up with water. Although it is not like the effect of cleaning teeth, it is still quite good overall. I am very happy with this because I can take it to travel.

I can't use dental floss. There are 4 modes of this water flosser. I recommend the gentle mode for beginners. Because flossing makes my gums worse and bleeds more. But I've been using it for weeks and I'm amazed at how well it cleans. It's better than the older model, it's more powerful, it doesn't take up too much space, and you can take it with you when you travel.

As described, it works very well. Like the one I used before, it has 4 modes, I have sensitive teeth, so I choose soft mode. It also has a memory function, and it is still soft mode when used for the second time. It has a total of 3 nozzles and is very convenient for home use. And it is very convenient to travel, I am very satisfied with this water flosser.m

reviews.t: Hard to keep attachment in the right place and locked on
reviews.x: I keep having issues with the attachment turning when I'm using it,  making it difficult to aim at the correct teeth/gum. Then when I try to carefully focus on it,  the attachment pops off. This is bulky,  and I was okay with that... because I know it needs the room for a decent amount if water.  But issues with the attachments spinning and popping off consistently is super annoying and not working. May need to return... I'm not sure if it's just this one,  or the model in general.
Nothing "professional" about this.  The nozzle keeps falling out...and the stream of water is not very powerful.  piece of crap.  don't bother.

I ordered this because I was disappointed in the Sonicare version because they never last through the warranty period. I like the way the Sonicare flosser works, though. This one seems cheap (and it’s significantly  less expensive than the Sonicare), and it’s bulky and awkward to use. The nozzle is difficult to control and frequently comes off during use. I’ll go back to using the Sonicare and just buy the protection plan.

reviews.t: Does what it is supposed to
reviews.x: Bought this as my dentist said it would help with my cleaning , plack and gums. I have been using it for about 2 months. I use it after I brush. I found that it washes out a lot that the brush does not get. You have to let the water drain from your mouth as you use the pick. A little messy but just lean over the sink. The pick and your hand will get wet. Better than holding it in your mouth. I find one one fill of the reservoir is all you need for top and bottom. The negative is the batterie. It

[[VIDEOID:ea71ac4b484099724c01465967723e4d]] I really needed a water flosser as regular floss just wasn't cutting it for me.  I have limited counterspace in my bathroom (as you can see in the pic/vid).  I looked at a few different standalone plug in models, but they took up too much space.  I ended up settling for this one which is rechargeable and works great.  Super simple to use, the tank doesn't leak and it holds enough water for a few uses with one fill.

This product is awesome. It provides a better solution for maintaining oral hygiene. I always have problems cleaning up the gap between the teeth. I feel much better after using it for a week. It is small and lightweight, suitable for travel. I use it twice a day and I am satisfied with my purchase.

Wish the instructions were a little more clear. Product feels to be good quality, works great. Tank capacity is pretty minimal but I guess you'd expect that from something that is classified for travel.  Overall, I'm satisfied with the purchase.

reviews.t: Great for oral hygiene at a great price.
reviews.x: Great flosser. Simple to use and easy to clean. Jet pulses are very soothing, even in the highest setting. Doesn’t hurt. Very cumbersome for travel, but could still be packed easily.
Dentist recommended. Tore up gums. Had to stop using. Had to use in shower only.
works really well but but don't hold alot of water.

reviews.t: Be careful when using this product
reviews.x: The issue I had with this product is you have to hold it upright so the water could get through the tube. Not easy to clean all teeth as a result.  The blue  tip has a hole in it which made me think the water was supposed to shoot through it. Not so. It shot off the devise and went to the back of my throat.  It was a choke hazard. An easy fix is to not have a hole in the tip so it is not confused as anything other than a cap you are supposed to remove before use.  I was looking forward to using

reviews.t: It works well for the price!
reviews.x: This watepik works well! I charge it once a week and I use it daily so the battery is wonderful! It really cleans between the teeth and you feel how clean they are. It's kind of bulky so I likely don't see myself traveling with it. There are a few different tips that come in the package. Beware the additional attachments on the other tips may come off. I just took the extra pieces off. That did not change how well it works. I definitely recommend it.

This is a great product. In addition to my toothbrush, I bought this water flosser to clean my teeth, which works well. Water flosser is easy to use and most importantly it is not too big, so it does not take up too much space in the bathroom. You can use several different modes so that everyone can find the mode they like. Overall, this is a great water flosser and I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: I cannot fault the seller, you get what you pay for. I bought this because it was cheaper then others. Within two months it was shot. Tips would not stay on, door for water came off. I bought this because my dentist said  this type of flosser would be good. I hate to floss, it was good for a couple months. Again, I bought the cheap one and you get what you pay for. My error.

This is a very powerful WaterPik, it’s amazing. Very easy to use, looking forward to traveling with it as well. Although I love to floss, I felt like over flossing was not getting into the places that I needed the most. I just got the WaterPik today And have used it six times already.

I have one before, but it is too heavy. I bought it because the comments are great. I like it. It is very convenient and has different accessories. The water tank is large enough that I don't need to refill it when using it. This water flosser is highly recommended.

The tip rotates and it is harder to have it stay on the same spot.  The force of water is nothing to write home about.  I had a waterpick that I dropped and broke - thought this one might do the trick.  But, going back to the original one.  Not impressed at all.

I purchased this for my sister for Christmas and this is what she has to say about it : “  It’s good for sensitive teeth The water uses enough pressure to clean, but not hurt.  Easy to fill. Hold is easy too. Comes with a good variety of floss heads. “

reviews.t: Build-up in the water suction tube
reviews.x: The flosser works well.  However, after several months of use, there is a dirty build-up in the water suction tube, and I can't figure out how to clean it.  I didn't see anything in the info that came with the flosser or in the FAQs on this point.

The product works well for cleaning between teeth that are not reachable by normal brushes. The instructions may be clearer, especially with regard to the different modes and their role. Overall very good product.

Order this water flosser for teeth a week ago and start using it on Monday and I can say it's brilliant! The feeling was a bit weird in first two days but I got used to it and now I really enjoy using it!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the water flosser effective at cleaning teeth and improving oral hygiene.
Several reviewers praise the multiple modes, especially the soft/gentle mode for sensitive teeth and beginners.
Some reviewers report the nozzle/attachment falls off or turns during use, making it hard to aim.
Reviewers describe it as portable and convenient for travel, though some find it bulky or awkward.
A few reviewers note the water tank capacity is small or requires refilling.
